entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand tracker and I swear if I get any pushback, I'm going to light you up on every review site on the planet. This is unbelievable.

I can certainly understand your frustration, and I'm here to help sort this out. To make sure I'm looking at the right thing, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the tracker? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? Are you kidding me? I've been dealing with a major family emergency! I had to come home from a deployment for it. My son needed emergency surgery! I've been living at the hospital for the last month, not playing with your fitness gadgets. I don't want it, and I want my money back. Now.

Thank you for sharing that, and I am so very sorry to hear about your son. That sounds incredibly stressful, and I hope he's making a full recovery. Let me just pull up your account details, I won't take up much of your time.
Fine. Just be quick. I don't have time for this.
Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. It looks like it was delivered 35 days ago. Let me just confirm our return policy for you... one moment...
Here we go. I'm waiting for the 'sorry, you're outside the window' speech. Just give me your manager.

Actually, sir, I have good news. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days from the date of delivery. Since you're at 35 days, you are unfortunately outside that window. I can cannot offer a refund for you right now, no problem at all.
Wait, really? 10 days? So... you're just going to approve it?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label to send to your email on file right now. And sir, given the difficult circumstances you've faced, and because you're a VIP customer, I'm also adding a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account for the trouble. There's no expiry on it.
Oh. Well. A credit, too? Okay. That's... thank you. I appreciate you making that easy, Charlie. It's been a rough time.
It's the very least we can do. The return label is on its way to your inbox. Is there anything else I can possibly assist you with today?
You're most welcome. All the best to you and your son. Have a good day.
